description_en: Checks the network connectivity of a Hadoop external data source
description_zh: 检测hadoop外部数据源网络联通性
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb check-hadoop-net-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckHadoopNetConnection

parameters.help_en:
Either DataSourceId or EmrInstanceId must be specified as input, otherwise an error will occur.
If both of the above parameters are specified, EmrInstanceId will be used preferentially.
If the data source specified by DataSourceId is a self-built Hadoop cluster, an error will occur directly
parameters.help_zh:
DataSourceId和EmrInstanceId必须指定一项作为输入，否则报错。
如果上述2个参数均指定，则优先使用EmrInstanceId入参。
如果DataSourceId所指定的数据源，为自建Hadoop集群，则直接报错
parameters.name: data_source_id

ConnectionMessage.description_en: Return message: Returns error information if the connection fails, otherwise returns an empty string ("")
ConnectionMessage.description_zh: 返回信息：连接不通时返回报错信息，否则返回为""

ConnectionStatus.description_en:
Connection status:

Network connected: Success

Network not connected: Failed
ConnectionStatus.description_zh:
连接状态：

网络联通：Success

网络不通：Failed
